title: Building Permits for Minor or Major Development or Other Construction Issued Before Effective Date of Amendment
previewText: The provisions of this Section shall apply to minor developments, major developments or other construction authorized by building permits lawfully issued before the effective date of an applicable amendment of this Resolution except as specifically provided elsewhere in this Resolution.
